Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Include a small
Markdown input with before and after output when it helps a reviewer.

## Validation

List the checks you ran from CONTRIBUTING.md and their actual results, and any
checks you could not run. For parsing, rendering, or AST changes, include the
comparison with the upstream executable.

## Compatibility

Explain any effect on public API, rendered output, the CLI, limits, or platform
support, and add a CHANGELOG entry for user-visible changes.
